Trading view
Peers trade at 11.1x to 12.0x NTM EBITDA (median 11.4x) and 12.0x to 13.2x LTM (median 12.4x): a 0.9x and 1.2x spread across eight companies.
EV / NTM revenue runs from 1.59x (Tessaly, 13.1% margin) to 2.76x (Penrose, 22.4%) and tracks margin with a correlation of 0.99: revenue multiples restate the EBITDA multiple, not a separate view.

Falcon's 18.9% LTM margin ranks 4 of 9 and its 5.8% NTM growth 3 of 9 (level with Varden), both within 0.3pp of the peer median, which supports applying the median multiple without a profile adjustment.
On the fitted line Falcon's margin implies 2.24x NTM revenue, $3,461m of EV, against $3,440m at the median NTM EBITDA multiple.

Falcon is smaller than six of eight peers: LTM revenue of $1,460m against a peer median of $2,990m. Larger peers trade somewhat higher (correlation 0.44 between EV and NTM EBITDA multiple), too few points to size a discount: no discount is applied, and this needs a view from the deal team.
Source: falcon_comps.csv (peer market data and consensus; Falcon management figures). Share prices and consensus estimates as of [pricing date to be confirmed].

Precedent transactions
Announced transactions, 2023-2026
EV in $m at announcement; multiples of LTM revenue and EBITDA; implied EBITDA and margin derived from EV and the two multiples

Sponsor buyers: KKR-backed Arcis, Blackstone and Carlyle; the five strategic acquirers are all in the peer set on sheet 1. Implied LTM EBITDA = EV / (EV / LTM EBITDA); implied margin = (EV / LTM revenue) / (EV / LTM EBITDA).
EV / LTM EBITDA by deal, ranked
x; sponsor buyers in navy, strategic buyers in grey
Deal size against multiple
$m and x; eight deals, r = 0.57; dashed line: Falcon's EV at the precedent median
Precedent view
Sponsors paid a median 12.9x LTM EBITDA across 3 deals, strategic buyers 11.1x across 5; three of the four highest multiples are sponsor deals.

The precedent median of 11.9x sits 4.4% below the listed peers' 12.4x LTM today, so the set shows no control premium over current trading. Peer multiples at each announcement date are not in the data; checking them would show whether markets have re-rated since.
No drift over time: deals announced in 2025-2026 have a median of 11.8x, those in 2023-2024 11.9x.
Implied target margins run 17.4% to 19.5% (median 18.5%), around Falcon's 18.9%.
Larger deals priced higher: the 3 deals of $2,000m or more have a median of 12.4x against 11.1x for the 5 smaller (correlation 0.57; eight deals is too few to rely on).
At the precedent median Falcon's EV is $3,284m, above the largest deal in the set (Ferro Controls, $3,210m): if size carries a premium, the precedent median understates Falcon.
Source: falcon_precedents.csv (announced transactions; EV and multiples at announcement); falcon_comps.csv for listed peer multiples.

Valuation view
The three EBITDA methods give $3,002m to $3,530m between their 25th and 75th percentiles, and all three overlap at $3,396m to $3,457m (shaded): 12.3x to 12.5x LTM EBITDA, 11.3x to 11.5x NTM.
Revenue methods span $2,779m to $3,639m, wider because peer revenue multiples vary with margin (sheet 1); they are shown for completeness and add little independent information.
Precedents sit lowest on both metrics: $3,284m at the median EBITDA multiple against $3,440m on NTM trading comps, because the deal set priced below where peers trade today (sheet 2).
No DCF or LBO range is shown: the data supplied covers market multiples only.
Implied equity value needs Falcon's net debt at the valuation date, which is not in the data supplied.
